title_en: Urban non-private wage source tables (classification-era archive)
title_zh: 城镇非私营单位就业人员平均工资历史
description_en: Official annual average wage and nominal growth by source table and explicit classification era for urban non-private units.
description_zh: 按原始发布表及明确行业分类时期保留的官方年度平均工资和名义增长率。
coverage_en: 2010-2021 retained Chinese NBS release tables; explicit GB/T 4754-2002, 2011 and 2017 eras; prior-year column excluded to prevent duplicate-vintage observations.
coverage_zh: 2010—2021年国家统计局中文发布表；GB/T 4754-2002、2011和2017时期明确分开；上年列不重复保留。
series_note_en: Source-table archive, not one continuous series. Classification and coverage changes are separate selector values and are never inferred across eras; use the longitudinal wage dataset for charts.
series_note_zh: 分类和覆盖变化作为独立选择项，绝不跨时期推断拼接。
source_note: Retained official NBS Chinese annual wage releases with source SHA-256.
